# Thick & Fit

> Creator-led, bilingual (English/Spanish) fitness coaching app for women, built by Stephanie Pantoja. Structured workouts with filmed demos, low-friction nutrition tracking (photo-to-macro, cooked/uncooked conversion), a living community, and coaching in Stephanie's own method and voice.

## What it is
- Fitness and nutrition coaching for women across the US and Latin America.
- Structured workout programs with Stephanie's filmed exercise demonstrations.
- Nutrition tracking built for real cooking: photo-to-macro, cooked-vs-raw gram conversion, and macro-based meal plans.
- A community feed, challenges, and progress tracking (weight, measurements, photos).
- Fully bilingual: every screen works in English and Spanish, chosen at onboarding.

## Tiers
- Self-Guided: app access with programming and nutrition tools.
- Team Thick & Fit: coached by Stephanie's team.
- 1-on-1 with Steph: direct personal coaching.
